segments.sn55.51:1.1: “Catūhi, bhikkhave, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo.
segments.sn55.51:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti – itipi so bhagavā … pe … satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
segments.sn55.51:2.4: Dhamme … pe … saṅghe … pe … ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi … pe … samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
segments.sn55.51:2.7: Imehi kho, bhikkhave, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyaṇo”ti.
segments.sn55.51:2.9: Idaṃ vatvāna sugato athāparaṃ etadavoca satthā –
segments.sn55.51:4.3: Adaliddoti taṃ āhu, amoghaṃ tassa jīvitaṃ.
